title: Inverse retained-witness refinement comparison is the ambient mate
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum and A a finite commutative ring in the site coefficient universe, with a discrete topology. Let X and Y be finite-type D.k-schemes [def-sf-operation-stages], let f:X -> Y be quasi-compact, let c,d be compactifications of f and r:c -> d a refinement. For every retained etale-origin object O [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism], the inverse of refinementComparisonAtWitness A r O equals RefinementProjection.finiteComparison D A r (refinementFixedObject X A O) [lem-sf-refinement-projection-counit]. No tensor, operation datum, separatedness of the structure maps or invertibility of a projection morphism is assumed.

proof.text: Use the bounded-below compatibility of the identity-normalized proper/open mate. The finite clopen site-transport equation identifies its bounded-below value on a comparison input with the etale gamma word. The direct-image comparison for the identity cancels the inserted identity. The refinement clause of proper/open interchange identifies the etale gamma word with the specified properOpenProEtaleIso. Include in the unbounded category through the canonical comparison isomorphisms.

Expand refinementProperOpenIso as transport along refinementFixedWitnessIso. Naturality of the normalized mate cancels the two witness isomorphisms, identifying this proper/open factor on the retained fixed-scalar object.

The ordinary inverse-image adjunction is exact, so its right adjoint preserves K-injective complexes. Apply Adjunction.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_eq_conjugateEquiv to upperStarComp and lowerStarComp. Compare the map-derived adjunction to the K-flat-derived adjunction through Adjunction.derived_eq_ofNatIsoLeft and the localization factorization of leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Expanding the two left-derived compositor constructions identifies finiteDirectImageComposition inverse with the conjugate of leftDerivedUpperStarComp. This is the same internal calculation used for ordinary-derived-composite-transpose, reproved here for general finite coefficients and schemes.

Invert the three factors of refinementComparisonAtWitness, substitute the preceding proper/open and compositor equations, and identify inverse equality transport with indexIso for r.hom_g. The resulting three-factor word is exactly finiteComparison.

lean.statement:
theorem refinementComparisonAtWitness_inv_eq
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    {X Y : Spaces D} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    {c d : Compactification f.hom.left} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (O : EtaleOriginDerivedCategory X.obj.left A) :
    (refinementComparisonAtWitness A r O).inv =
      RefinementProjection.finiteComparison D A r
        (refinementFixedObject X.obj.left A O)
